list.name: thing_id
list.label: Asset
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "raw", tag: "thing_id", predicate: (r) => r.feature_id == "battery", start: -30d)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry" and r.thing_id == "${thing_id}" and r._field == "soc" and r.feature_id == "battery")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, feature: r.feature_id}))
  |> group(columns: ["feature"])
